literal_meaning: লেজ তুলে দেখা (tail lifting to see)
figurative_meaning_en: Attempting to understand the real situation or truth
similar_in_english: Get to the bottom of something
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে লেজ তুলে দেখল যে ব্যাপারটা আসলে কী।
এই ঘটনার পিছনে লেজ তুলে দেখা দরকার।
example_sentences_in_english: He lifted the tail to see what the matter really was.
We need to get to the bottom of this incident.
note: This idiom draws from rural imagery of examining hidden aspects, like checking under an animal's tail.
